# Contoso Retail — Supplier Labeling and Packaging Guidelines

Version 3.2, effective March 1, 2026. These guidelines apply to every apparel, footwear and accessories supplier delivering to the Contoso Retail distribution center in Pudahuel, Santiago. Send questions to the inbound logistics team at proveedores@contoso.example.

## Product labels and hang tags

- Every unit carries a hang tag with the Contoso SKU, size, color and an EAN-13 barcode. Barcodes must scan on the first attempt; tags that fail are relabeled at the supplier's expense.
- Fiber composition, country of origin and care instructions go on a sewn-in label in Spanish, as required by Chilean regulations.
- Do not print retail prices on tags or packaging. Prices are applied at the distribution center.
- Footwear: the size label goes inside the tongue, and the end label of the shoebox shows SKU, color, Chilean size and barcode.

## Polybags and folding

- Each garment ships folded in its own transparent polybag of at least 50 microns, with a suffocation warning printed in Spanish.
- The standard folded size is 30 x 40 cm; coats and parkas may be folded to 35 x 45 cm.
- The polybag carries a barcode sticker that matches the hang tag, on the front, upper right corner.
- Garments on hangers (blazers and wool coats) are accepted only when the purchase order says GOH.

## Master cartons

- Maximum carton size: 60 x 40 x 40 cm.
- Maximum gross weight: 18 kg per carton.
- Use double-wall corrugated cartons with no straps or staples.
- Pack one SKU and size per carton whenever possible. Mixed cartons need a packing list in a document pouch on the outside.
- Label every carton on two adjacent sides with the purchase order number, SKU, quantity, gross weight and carton number (for example, 3 of 12).

## Advance Shipping Notice (ASN)

Submit the ASN in the supplier portal at least 48 hours before the delivery appointment. It must list the purchase order, the number of cartons and the quantity of each SKU and size in every carton. A difference of more than 2% between the ASN and the units received counts as a non-compliance, and we may receive the delivery only partially until the supplier confirms the count.

## Delivery appointments

- Book every delivery in the supplier portal at least 72 hours in advance.
- Receiving hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 14:00. We do not receive on Chilean public holidays.
- During peak season, from October 15 to December 15, we also receive on Saturdays from 9:00 to 12:00.
- Trucks arriving more than 30 minutes late lose their slot and are moved to the next available day.

## Non-compliance penalties

| Non-compliance | Penalty |
|---|---|
| Missing or late ASN | CLP 150,000 per delivery |
| Wrong or missing carton label | CLP 8,000 per carton |
| Carton over 18 kg | CLP 12,000 per carton |
| Missed appointment (no-show) | CLP 250,000 per appointment |
| Unit without hang tag or barcode | CLP 1,500 per unit |

Penalties are deducted from the next payment to the supplier. Suppliers with three or more non-compliances in the same quarter are reviewed by the buying team and may lose their Saturday slots during peak season.
